## What kind of change?

- [ ] New lesson (`src/content/lessons/<slug>.mdx`)
- [ ] New agent (`src/content/agents/<slug>.mdx`)
- [ ] New use case (`src/content/useCases/<slug>.mdx`)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation / typo
- [ ] Refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] Frontmatter matches the schema in `src/content/config.ts`
- [ ] `pnpm exec astro check` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds locally
- [ ] PR preview URL verified (commented by bot)
- [ ] Linked any related issue
